name: SEX Massage 🔞
source:
In the exciting visual novel [b]SEX Massage [/b], you will take on the role of a young massage parlor owner in a picturesque resort town. The main character has inherited this spa and is facing incredible challenges and opportunities.

Your goal is to grow the business by providing excellent massage services. Gradually, you will be able to improve your salon and win the hearts of your clients.

Help the main character to achieve his dream by earning money for it.

Get ready for the exciting and intriguing world of business and spa treatments in [b]SEX Massage[/b].

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在令人心潮澎湃的视觉小说《[b]SEX Massage[/b]》中，你将扮演风景如画的度假小镇上一家按摩院的年轻老板。主人公继承了这家水疗会所，正面临着前所未有的挑战与机遇。

你的目标是凭借精湛的按摩服务把生意做大做强。一步步升级店面设施，赢得客人们的芳心吧。

努力赚钱，帮助主人公实现他的梦想。

准备好踏入《[b]SEX Massage[/b]》那充满诱惑与激情的商业及水疗世界吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666200/]Steam[/url]]
